scope: Required saved auxiliary character state before admission: companions/medals, account mounts/saddle, recalls/buffs, hotkey pages, allegiance and owned premium/EXP items. Functional persistence repair; no publisher balance/content claims.
implemented: ICharacterAuxiliaryStore routes recalls, hotkeys, aid country and timed items through a required-load path. Production defaults to GameDatabase; missing auxiliary override still falls back to the configured game DB. Required failures propagate to the existing client/world admission gate before ClientSession.Char is published.

Pet/saddle and companion loaders no longer catch errors and continue with empty state. Empty successful results still permit a new character. Read failures remove the session, return the existing Internal result and close it; queued handshake packets cannot promote it.

Read the pet list successfully before applying the saddle/pet state. Reject incomplete companion arrays and incomplete hotkey pages. A character with only some rows loaded never becomes playable or eligible for a full save.

Hotkey SQL reads reject missing positional fields instead of silently skipping pages, while preserving the existing handling of additional trailing columns. Loaded pages retain their existing save flags.

Preserve the DB-backed current-HP/MP clamp after premium and companion state loads; keep recall reconstruction, skill/buff loading, chart filtering and premium durations unchanged. Quest admission barriers and FIFO journal recovery remain.

Keep the existing optional PC-bang-procedure fallback only after owned premium and EXP rows load. Failure of either owned-item query propagates; missing optional PC-bang support does not discard successfully loaded owned items.
